guarantees.claim: cnt_en is asynchronously cleared to 0 when rst_ni is low, regardless of other signals.
cnt_en is set to 1 on the next rising clock edge after edn_done is sampled high, when not in reset.
cnt_en holds its previous value when not in reset and edn_done is low (no explicit write).

assumptions.claim: edn_done is a synchronous pulse signal that can be sampled at the rising clock edge; its timing and duration are controlled externally.
assumptions.risk: If edn_done is not pulsed but stays high, cnt_en will be set again on each clock, which may be harmless but could violate single-shot re-seed expectations.

assumptions.claim: The asynchronous reset rst_ni must be asserted during power-up and removed after clocks are stable.
assumptions.risk: Incorrect reset removal could cause cnt_en to have an unknown state or metastability.

uncertain_points.claim: Once cnt_en becomes 1, there is no mechanism in this always_ff block to clear it back to 0, except a full reset. This may prevent multiple re-seed operations or override external clear attempts.
uncertain_points.cond: after edn_done is asserted and no reset occurs
uncertain_points.risk: If multiple re-seed operations are needed, cnt_en will remain stuck at 1 and might prevent subsequent re-seed sequences or handshakes from restarting.
